Name: Overseer
Description: A bat-like Hetero-Creature the Mirror Demon created with its own blood as the mark, using the power of the Red Tide.

Name: Chiko
Description: Tired of living as a "hero" in a repeating lie, he plunges into an abyss of no return and becomes "Ephialtes".

Name: Unidentified Twins
Description: Guardian of the Delorean starship, modified from Nanami's companion, Power, with a design inspired by the golden age movie "Oceanic Rim".

Name: Lloyd
Description: Comes from "the timeline wiped out as a result of the disappearance of the Hetero Tower." A Construct that travels to the past to save the future. Has two battle forms—the Knight Form and the Human Form.
